story: Six riders formed an early breakaway, including Veistroffer, who extended his KOM lead. After the final climb, the attackers were caught as crosswinds split the peloton. Remco Evenepoel attacked from the front group, with Jonas Vingegaard following, but their cooperation was poor. Evenepoel did most of the work before crashing in the final couple hundred meters. Vingegaard sat up, allowing Dorian Godon to win the bunch sprint.
